# js8spotter

**JS8Call's companion — spot tracking, forms, APRS and SMS gateways**

- **Version recorded:** 1.20
- **Categories:** `digital-modes`, `emcomm`
- **Upstream:** <https://kf7mix.com/js8spotter.html>
- **Needs first:** `python3-tk`, `python3-pil`, `python3-pil.imagetk`

## What it does

A companion to JS8Call: watches its API for activity, tracks spots and stations on a map, exchanges forms, and gateways to APRS and SMS -- the EMCOMM side of JS8 that JS8Call itself leaves to companions.

## Why you would want it

If JS8Call is your keyboard, this is your logbook-and-dispatch desk: who was heard where, forms traffic for nets, and reach into APRS.

## Before it will work

JS8Call running with its TCP API enabled (Settings -> Reporting -> API). Everything arrives over the local API; no radio access of its own.

## How it installs

- prebuilt zip from https://kf7mix.com/files/js8spotter/js8spotter-120_src.zip
  - AHRL v27 shipped 1.18; upstream is at 1.20 (fetched and hashed 2026-08-30). AHRL also apt-installs python3-tksnack for it -- one of the four suspected-stale dependency lines D-016 records; 1.20 runs without it and it is deliberately absent here.

## Known problems

Runs in place from the installed tree via the generated `js8spotter` launcher; its SQLite database is created in the working directory on first run, so per-user data lands in the tree unless you set the DB path in File -> Settings. A per-user copy is the upstream-documented alternative if that bothers you.

## Keeping it current

- probe: none
- strategy: reinstall
- Versioned zips at kf7mix.com/js8spotter.html; KF7MIX releases a few times a year. Bump the URL and hash together.
